messages.author: 2c7106159c8e6d5b
messages.subject: DO majority/minority founder alleles
parts:
Hello,

In the online genotype diagnostics guide for DO mice (https://kbroman.org/qtl2/assets/vignettes/do_diagnostics.html), one thing that gets re-evaluated is whether the founder majority/minority allele designations are correct. The function you've provided corrects these designations, but only in the context of the diagnostics routine; the original assignments persist in the data one would use to run a QTL analysis.

So, do the same re-assignments need to be applied to the founder and DO sample allele designations prior to QTL analysis? If so, is the function you provide on your diagnostics page already embedded in one of the QTL functions, or does this need to be done 'by hand'?

Thanks very much.

David

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] DO majority/minority founder alleles
parts:
The coding of the SNP genotypes won't have any effect on QTL mapping results, and we haven't implemented anything to do any re-coding.

karl
